svg.title: Project 3: Highly available multi-tier web application
svg.desc: Users reach an internet-facing Application Load Balancer through the internet gateway. The load balancer sends traffic to EC2 web servers in private subnets across two Availability Zones, run by an Auto Scaling group. The web servers read database credentials from Secrets Manager and query RDS MySQL in private database subnets. Outbound updates go through a NAT gateway, and admin access runs through Systems Manager Session Manager.

text.tspan: Project 3: Highly available multi-tier web application
Three tiers across two Availability Zones: a public load balancer, private web servers that scale on their own, and a private MySQL database.
only reachable from the web tier
Users reach the load balancer through the internet gateway on port 80.
It sends traffic only to healthy web servers in either zone. Desired capacity is 2.
Web servers fetch the database credentials from Secrets Manager.
Only the web tier can reach MySQL. The database has no internet route.
Private web servers get software updates out through the NAT gateway.
Admin access goes through Session Manager. There is no SSH port to open.
The Auto Scaling group adds a server when average CPU goes above 50%.
